editorial.blurb: Seoul Stick serves up crispy Korean street food favorites—especially their signature corn dogs and tteokbokki—in a fun, casual spot complete with a photo booth.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Original Corn Dog with spicy mayo and grab a condiment from the register lineup; food comes out in under 5 minutes, and you can customize between beef sausage, plant sausage, or mozzarella at the same price.
